mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, provider_key, secret_id, token_type, scope, expires_at, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM ds_oauth_credential WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND provider_key = #{providerKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_oauth_credential (id, tenant_id, user_id, provider_key, secret_id, token_type, scope, expires_at, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{providerKey}, #{secretId}, #{tokenType}, #{scope}, #{expiresAt}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
